name: Rockets: Stuck in the Air and Landing Together

pages.text: $(l)Stuck at high altitude after planet entry$()$(li)If your rocket is stuck high above the surface (e.g., Y=1000), bind $(l)Open Rocket GUI$() to a key.$(li)Press the $(l)descent key$() (default $(5)Space$()) and wait for altitude to drop to 0.
$(li)Then open the rocket GUI and disassemble it—this keeps the planet chip but uses up the remaining fuel.

$(l)Landing on a planet in multiplayer$()$(li)Have two players in the rocket, on different seats, before landing.$(li)If loading stalls during landing, one player must disconnect while the other stays in the rocket.$(li)Otherwise the rocket may disappear entirely.
